**Status:** Implemented post-REDCap procedure; pre-extraction sign-off details require BNR confirmation.  
**Owner:** BNR Lead and BNR Analyst.

## Purpose

A data release is the identified cumulative REDCap extract used for one analytical cycle. It records the release year and month, the extraction time and the source receipt so that results can be reproduced even after REDCap records change.

## Before starting

Confirm that:

- the intended release year and month are unambiguous and the month has ended;
- expected case finding, abstraction and record approval are sufficiently complete;
- release-blocking queries and duplicates have been resolved;
- known late records and unresolved outcomes have been reviewed;
- REDCap structural changes have been communicated to the analyst; and
- the BNR Lead or delegated role has authorised extraction.

## Step-by-step procedure

1. Record the release year and month and any accepted limitation, such as known late records.
2. Open Stata on the authorised workstation and load the BNR menu if it is not already available.
3. Choose **User > BNR > Update CVD dashboard > Step 1: Extract REDCap data**.
4. Enter the authorised release year and month. Leave replacement off for a first extraction.
5. Select **Run extract**.
6. Confirm that the Stata summary reports `Completed successfully`, the intended period and a plausible record count.
7. Check that the raw CSV, Stata copy, YAML extraction receipt and private log were created together.
8. Open the receipt and confirm its dates and record count. Stop if they do not match the authorised release.
9. Record that the release is ready for CVD events Step 2.

Later REDCap corrections belong to a new or explicitly authorised replacement analytical cycle. Do not alter or relabel the retained extract.

## Stop points

Stop if the reporting period, project, authority, field structure, record count or extraction result is uncertain. Do not use output from a failed or partial Step 1 run.

## Evidence retained

- authorisation and reporting period;
- accepted limitations;
- raw CSV and Stata source copy;
- extraction receipt; and
- private Stata log.

::: {.callout-warning title="BNR confirmation required"}
Confirm the operational sign-off used before extraction, the normal monthly timing and which unresolved record issues postpone a release.
:::
